001A.t: It smelled faintly{SoftNewLine}of a young girl...{ContinuePrompt}

001B.t: The contents were so wild,{SoftNewLine}it only made you dizzy.....{ContinuePrompt}

0080.t: {Speaker}W-wait! D-don't{SoftNewLine}touch that book! It's... full of{SoftNewLine}dangerous spells! Yes, spells!{WaitInput}

0083.t: {Speaker}Oh dear... Very{SoftNewLine}well. O goddess, forgive me!{WaitInput}

0084.t: {Speaker}W-wonderful book,{SoftNewLine}eh? Please keep it a secret{SoftNewLine}from the villagers, will you?{WaitInput}

0085.t: {Speaker}Wise choice, my{SoftNewLine}child! You'll go far in this{SoftNewLine}world. Ahem.{WaitInput}

0086.t: {Speaker}No, no! Don't take{SoftNewLine}it outside! If anyone sees it,{SoftNewLine}my reputation is ruined!{WaitInput}

087D.t: {Speaker}What's this outfit?!{SoftNewLine}You think I'd wear something{SoftNewLine}this naughty? Nigel, you perv!{WaitInput}

087E.t: {Speaker}Kyaa, thanks, Nigel!{SoftNewLine}I always wanted to wear a{SoftNewLine}bunny girl outfit once!!{WaitInput}
